versions.content: If the call to Dcm_ReadMemory returns DCM_READ_FORCE_RCRRP, the Dcm shall invoke the transmit request for RCR-RP (NRC 0x78 transmission) and the Dcm shall not realize further invocation of the operation till RCR-RP is transmitted.
